source_name: NBS – Registre (master index of all NBS registers)
why_relevant: Single index page enumerating every NBS register (PSD2, RBUZ, creditors, financial agents, CERI, AIF managers). Best snowball surface for discovering registers this cell has not yet mapped.

source_name: NBS legacy site tree (www.nbs.sk/sk/publikacie/... and /_img/documents/...)
why_relevant: Pre-redesign NBS site tree still serves many historical PDFs (annual-report chapters by year, supervision reports, statistics methodology). Indispensable for long time series of narrative documents that the new nbs.sk navigation no longer surfaces.

source_name: NBS – Biatec, odborný bankový časopis (archive 1993–2019)
why_relevant: Discontinued NBS banking journal with a deep per-year, per-issue archive. Best historical narrative source for the pre-2020 evolution of Slovak payment systems, card acceptance, ATM networks and cash logistics.

source_name: Archív Národnej banky Slovenska (archiv.nbs.sk) — institutional/physical archive and research portal
why_relevant: Statutory archive (act 395/2002) holding 200+ archival fonds from defunct monetary institutions and the Czechoslovak State Bank, with a bádateľský portál (researcher portal). Not a source of modern payment statistics — inspection showed no statistics sections — but the correct route for pre-digital and long-retired NBS records and for formal document requests.

source_name: NBS – Zoznam registrov údajov o spotrebiteľských úveroch (list of consumer-credit data registries)
why_relevant: Names the private credit bureaus (e.g. bank and non-bank registers) operating in SK — each of which is itself a holder of aggregate lending/card statistics and a potential commercial data source.

source_name: Ministerstvo obrany SR – verejné obstarávanie (example ministry buyer profile)
why_relevant: Illustrates the standard per-ministry procurement page pattern in SK. Every ministry, Sociálna poisťovňa, Finančná správa and Štátna pokladnica maintains an equivalent page — collectively the enumerable set of public buyers of card-acceptance and cash services.

source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie profilov / profil verejného obstarávateľa
why_relevant: Every contracting authority (incl. NBS, Slovenská pošta, state banks, Sociálna poisťovňa) has a legally mandated profile aggregating its notices, contracts and award documents. It is the fastest way to enumerate the actor map of public buyers of payment/cash infrastructure and then snowball into their documents.

source_name: Štatistický úrad SR — Elektronický zber údajov (zber.statistics.sk) survey catalogue
why_relevant: Catalogue of every statistical survey ŠÚ SR runs, with questionnaires and legal basis. Reading the questionnaires reveals which payment/cash variables are actually collected (and therefore what could be requested or published later) — a pointer that expands the actor and variable map well beyond what is published as headline tables.

source_name: Štatistický úrad SR — Open data section (portal hub)
why_relevant: Entry point describing ŠÚ SR's open-data offering and linking to the API help; the reliable route to discover new machine-readable products and format changes.

source_name: Ministry of Finance SR — Rating Agencies page (agency reports on SK)
why_relevant: Official pointer page collecting/linking S&P, Moody's, Fitch assessments of Slovakia — a low-friction index into agency material that is otherwise behind registration.

source_name: Eurostat Statistics Explained — Digital society statistics at regional level
why_relevant: Editorial layer that names the exact dataset codes and NUTS2 regional cuts (e.g. Bratislavský kraj vs other SK regions for internet banking) — a fast route to the right underlying tables and to regional payment-adoption gaps.

source_name: Eurostat Statistics Explained (Slovak edition) — e.g. Beginners: Government finance statistics /sk
why_relevant: Confirms Eurostat publishes Slovak-language explainer pages; gives the official Slovak statistical vocabulary (bezhotovostné platby, platobná bilancia, štatistika) that can be reused as search terms against SK-language re-publishers of Eurostat data.

source_name: SBA — Členovia / Members list
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of ~24 members (full members = banks/branches; associate members = infrastructure firms). Reveals every deposit-taker worth monitoring plus infrastructure actors such as Regional Card Processing Centre, Nexi Group, Centrálny depozitár cenných papierov SR, Eximbanka — a snowball seed for the whole SK entity map.

source_name: BIS CPMI — Payment, clearing and settlement in various countries (country pages index)
why_relevant: Index of narrative country/jurisdiction Red Book chapters; the route to confirm exactly how the euro area chapter treats SK and which national chapters exist. Also snowballs to national central bank payment-system publications.

source_name: Banky.sk – bank profiles and card-market articles
why_relevant: Slovak banking portal that compiles per-bank card and network figures and cites the underlying bank/NBS releases — an efficient pointer for discovering which banks published which KPI and when.

source_name: data.europa.eu — Slovakia country insights (open data maturity)
why_relevant: Maps which Slovak public bodies publish open data and how mature the SK portal ecosystem is — tells us where SK payment/financial datasets are likely to appear and how reliably they are refreshed.

source_name: EBA – Registers and other lists of institutions (credit institutions register hub)
why_relevant: Hub for the EBA credit institutions register and other 'other lists' (e.g. exempted entities, crowdfunding); lets the SK bank/acquirer universe be reconciled against an EU-consistent identifier set.

source_name: Legacy ECB Statistical Data Warehouse (sdw.ecb.europa.eu) — Slovakia payments country tables
why_relevant: The retired SDW front-end (superseded by data.ecb.europa.eu) still surfaces in indexes with a Slovakia payments country-table node. Useful as a legacy-identifier map (old node/series keys → new dataset keys) and as a Wayback target where the old tables were laid out differently.

source_name: Zoznam bánk na Slovensku (Slovak Wikipedia)
why_relevant: Free, structured actor map of Slovak banks and branches of foreign banks with official names and links — useful for building the entity/alias list media coverage must be matched against (e.g. Slovenská sporiteľňa / SLSP, Tatra banka, VÚB, ČSOB, 365.bank, Prima banka, Fio, mBank, UniCredit).

source_name: Wikipédia (sk) — Slovenská banková asociácia / Úverový register
why_relevant: Cheap orientation layer giving official Slovak names, founding dates, and outbound links to association and register bodies; used purely as a pointer for terminology and actor discovery, never as an evidence source.

entity_name: ATM Marketplace / ATMIA vendor showrooms and showcases
source_name: ATM Marketplace / ATMIA vendor showrooms and showcases
why_relevant: Industry-trade aggregators that host vendor showrooms, product showcases and deployment news across the ATM/self-service industry. Good snowballing surface for identifying which OEMs, software vendors and managed-service firms are active in CEE, and for catching SK deployment announcements that never reach SK media.

source_name: BOWA – zoznam integrátorov e-kasa (list of e-kasa integrators)
why_relevant: SK-specific: e-kasa (fiscal cash register) integrators are the channel through which POS terminals reach small merchants. This list enumerates software vendors bridging ECR and payment terminals — actors invisible to payment statistics but decisive for terminal penetration.

source_name: CRZP — Centrálny register záverečných prác (Slovak central theses repository, CVTI SR)
why_relevant: National repository of all Slovak bachelor/master/doctoral and habilitation theses, retained 70 years. Theses on Slovak card usage, ATM networks and cash demand routinely reproduce NBS tables and bank-supplied figures for years whose original online sources are gone — a genuine long-tail recovery surface for retired series.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf - banking case studies / success stories library
why_relevant: DN publishes quantified ATM-estate case studies for CEE banks (e.g. a CSOB case study citing end-to-end ATM network outsourcing and 99.8% uptime over a ~20-year relationship; bank99 six-year ATM-as-a-Service). CSOB has a Slovak arm, so the CEE case-study library is the highest-yield vendor surface for SK/CZ ATM outsourcing evidence. Note: I did not find a case study explicitly scoped to Slovakia.

source_name: e-Justice EU – Business registers in Slovakia (country page)
why_relevant: EU-maintained explainer of which SK registers exist, who runs them, what they legally contain and how to search them — an authoritative meta-source for validating the register map and its coverage limits.

source_name: EEA s.r.o. - Referencie, segment 'Banky a finančný sektor'
why_relevant: Segment-filtered reference directory for SK banking clients (e.g. Tatra banka toolchain integration and a CMDB consolidation across ~30 systems). The segment filter makes it a clean, machine-friendly pointer surface listing named SK financial-sector customers.

source_name: European Commission Library — Fintech / Digital Finance statistics and data guide
why_relevant: Librarian-curated inventory of EU and international statistics sources on payments and digital finance — a high-yield snowball surface listing aggregators we might otherwise miss, with notes on coverage and access.

source_name: FINAS — Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia
why_relevant: Second, newer SK fintech/insurtech association; separate member base from Slovenská FinTech asociácia, so both are needed for full coverage of the non-bank payments actor map.

source_name: FinGO.sk blog
why_relevant: Broker-run reference listing of banks operating in Slovakia — a compact actor map for snowballing into each institution's press room, branch/ATM locator and fee schedule. Pointer value, not statistical value.

source_name: MH SR — Zoznam subjektov alternatívneho riešenia sporov (ADR entity register)
why_relevant: Official Ministry of Economy register of ADR bodies — authoritative list of who may handle financial/payment consumer disputes in SK, and therefore who publishes complaint statistics.

source_name: paymentproviders.io – Slovak payment providers directory
why_relevant: Aggregator claiming 200+ gateway comparisons filtered to the SK market — a fast way to enumerate long-tail PSPs serving SK that never appear in local press. Low credibility on facts, high value as a name-harvesting pointer.

source_name: SAVA — Slovenská asociácia výskumných agentúr (member directory)
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of SK market-research vendors; the cleanest way to enumerate every agency that could be commissioned for payment-behaviour or cash-usage studies, including small local players invisible to English search.
